mathematics.title: Mathematics
formulas: Euler's Formula: e^(ix) = cos(x) + i * sin(x)
Rank of Matrix: Number of non-zero rows in Echelon form
memory_tricks: Integration by parts: ILATE (Inverse, Logarithmic, Algebraic, Trigonometric, Exponential)
revision_points: Always check boundary conditions in differential equations.
Matrix multiplication is NOT necessarily commutative.

physics.title: Engineering Physics
formulas: De Broglie Wavelength: λ = h / p
memory_tricks: VIBGYOR helps remember wavelength order (Violet shortest, Red longest)
revision_points: Lasers require population inversion.
Optical fibers work on Total Internal Reflection.

chemistry.title: Engineering Chemistry
formulas: Hardness of Water: (Mass of hardness producing substance / Eq. wt of substance) * 50
Calorific Value: HCV = LCV + Latent heat of steam
memory_tricks: OIL RIG (Oxidation Is Loss, Reduction Is Gain of electrons)
LEO the lion says GER (Lose Electrons = Oxidation, Gain Electrons = Reduction)
revision_points: EDTA method requires EBT indicator at pH 9-10.
Anodic metal corrodes, cathodic metal is protected.

c_programming.title: C Programming
memory_tricks: Call by Value (Copy), Call by Reference (Address => Address modifies original)
revision_points: Arrays are zero-indexed.
Do not return pointers to local variables.
Strings must end with a null character '\0'.

beee.title: BEEE
formulas: Power AC: P = V * I * cos(φ)
memory_tricks: CIVIL (In a Capacitor (C), I leads V. In an Inductor (L), V leads I)
revision_points: Series circuit: Current is same. Parallel circuit: Voltage is same.
Transformers only work on AC.

data_structures.title: Data Structures
formulas: Array Indexing (1D to 2D Row Major): addr = base + w * (cols * i + j)
memory_tricks: LIFO for Stacks (Plates in a cafeteria), FIFO for Queues (Line at a ticket counter)
revision_points: Linked lists require sequential access; arrays allow random access.
Binary Search requires a sorted array. Time complexity: O(log n).

english.title: Communicative English
formulas: Essay Structure: Introduction -> Body Paragraphs -> Conclusion
Email Format: Subject -> Salutation -> Body -> Sign-off
memory_tricks: FANBOYS for coordinating conjunctions (For, And, Nor, But, Or, Yet, So)
revision_points: Keep technical emails concise and professional.
Use transition words to maintain paragraph flow.
Proofread for Subject-Verb agreement.

engineering_graphics.title: Engineering Graphics
formulas: Representative Fraction (RF): Drawing size / Actual size
Eccentricity: Distance from Focus / Distance from Directrix
revision_points: First Angle: Object is between Observer and Plane.
Third Angle: Plane is between Observer and Object.
Continuous thick lines for visible outlines, dashed for hidden edges.

bcme.title: BCME
formulas: Strain: ε = Change in Length / Original Length
Work Done: W = Force * Distance * cos(θ)
memory_tricks: Hooke's Law: Stress is proportional to Strain (within elastic limit)
revision_points: Concrete is strong in compression, weak in tension.
Four-stroke engine cycle: Intake, Compression, Power, Exhaust.
